text: {"changed_files": ["lib/kstrtox.c"], "summary": "Fixed the digit-validity check in _parse_integer_limit from `val > base` to `val >= base`, so simple_strtol no longer accepts 'a' as a base-10 digit (this made get_options expand ranges like \"5-a\")."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/kstrtox.c"], "summary": "Fixed the inverted `s[0]` check in `_parse_integer_fixup_radix()`, which picked octal or hex for strings that don't start with '0' and decimal for those that do, so decimal numbers like \"9\" and \"4-8\" were parsed as octal and failed."}
{"changed_files": ["lib/string_helpers.c"], "summary": "In unescape_octal(), `num << 3;` discarded its result, so multi-digit octal escapes were wrong; changed it to `num <<= 3;`."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/string_helpers.c"], "summary": "In unescape_hex(), `*q--` moved the pointer back onto the backslash instead of forward past the 'x', so `\\xHH` escapes were never decoded. I changed it to `*q++`, which matches upstream. I couldn't build or run the tests here."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/string_helpers.c"], "summary": "escape_passthrough() advanced the output pointer by 2 instead of 1, which doubled the escaped output length (64 vs 32); I changed it back to 1."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/string_helpers.c"], "summary": "In escape_space(), `--out` after writing the backslash should be `++out`; the decrement made the output pointer move backward and produced wrong escaped lengths."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/string_helpers.c"], "summary": "In escape_special(), the output pointer was decremented (`--out`) instead of incremented (`++out`) after writing the escape character, so special characters were not advanced past correctly and the output length came out wrong."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/string_helpers.c"], "summary": "In escape_null(), the output pointer was decremented (`--out`) instead of incremented after writing `\\0`, so the escaped length was wrong. I changed it to `++out`. I couldn't build or run the tests here, so the fix is untested."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/string_helpers.c"], "summary": "In escape_octal(), the pointer was decremented (`--out`) instead of incremented before writing the middle octal digit, so escaped output was corrupted and came out too short; I changed it to `++out`."}
{"changed_files": ["lib/string_helpers.c"], "summary": "In escape_hex(), `--out` should have been `++out`; the bug made the output pointer back up and produced the wrong escaped length."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/cmdline.c"], "summary": "In get_options(), the loop-exit check was inverted (`res != 1` instead of `res == 1`), so parsing stopped after the first comma or range instead of at the last number."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/cmdline.c"], "summary": "In get_range(), the range expansion wrote values with `*pint--` and so walked backwards through the array. I changed it to `*pint++`. I couldn't build or run the tests here, so this is untested."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/cmdline.c"], "summary": "In get_option(), the negative-number branch used `--cur` instead of `++cur`, so it parsed from the wrong position and the leading hyphen was never skipped; I changed it back to `++cur`. I couldn't build or run the tests here, so the fix is unverified."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/cmdline.c"], "summary": "In get_option(), a leading '-' was handled with `--cur` instead of `++cur`. The sign was re-parsed from the wrong position, which broke negative numbers and ranges. I changed it back to `++cur`. I couldn't build or run the tests here, so the fix is untested."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/string_helpers.c"], "summary": "In lib/string_helpers.c, `string_get_size` now does `i++` instead of `i--` when reducing `size`, and `string_escape_mem` reads the source with `*src++` instead of `*src--`. I couldn't build or run the tests."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/string_helpers.c"], "summary": "In string_unescape(), the escape check tested `src[1] == '\\0'` instead of `src[1] != '\\0'`, so escape sequences were never unescaped; I restored the `!=`."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/string_helpers.c"], "summary": "Fixed string_get_size's Napier reduction, which now adds 2 to the exponent per divide in both loops instead of ±1, and string_unescape's escape check, which now tests `src[1] != '\\0'` instead of `== '\\0'`."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/string_helpers.c"], "summary": "Fixed two bugs in lib/string_helpers.c: string_get_size() decremented the exponent (i--) instead of incrementing it when reducing size, and escape_passthrough() advanced the output pointer by 2 instead of 1."}
{"changed_files": ["lib/string.c"], "summary": "strncasecmp() decremented the s1 pointer (`*s1--`) instead of incrementing it, so I changed it to `*s1++`."}

{"changed_files": ["lib/siphash.c"], "summary": "Fixed the tail-length mask in __siphash_aligned and __hsiphash_aligned (the 64-bit hsiphash variant), where `sizeof(u64) - 2` should have been `sizeof(u64) - 1`. With the wrong mask, odd tail lengths were computed incorrectly."}
